column3: “Take a census” renders “lift up the head,” and “by their families” renders “by their clans” (throughout the chapter).
“enter the service” renders “come for the host (tsava),” military-style service.
“the most holy things” renders “the holy of holies.”
“the veil of the screen” renders “the curtain (parokhet) of the screen.”
“porpoise skin” renders “tahash skin,” an animal whose identity is uncertain (throughout the chapter), and “pure blue” renders “entirely of violet.”
“the table of the bread of the Presence” renders “the table of the face.”
“the carrying bars” renders “the carrying frame (mot)” (also in verse 12).
“the most holy objects” renders “the holy of holies,” and “his load” renders “his burden.”
“even for a moment” renders “as a swallowing.”
“Take a census” renders “lift up the head.”
“at the command of” renders “at the mouth of.”
“under the direction of” renders “in the hand of” (also in verse 33).
